title: Sequence of bands and end of tape
summary: Nash places the early groups around 1909 and recaps the Peter Williams band personnel before the tape ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well, now, let's see. After Peter Williams came, huh?

After Peter Williams? After I came, I mean, I came to Peter Williams after these guys. These guys way back in, way back in, oh, this way back around 19, around 19, let me see, around 1910 and nine, 19, nine, up in nine, them years.
Yeah, but who did you play with after you played with Peter Williams?
Oh, I played with Peter Williams and Kid George, trumpet player. Peter played drums. Had one guy play the saxophone, one play the clarinet. But I can't think of those guys, man. Been so long.
Well, that looks like a mate. End of the tape. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
